verses.1: And God remembered Noah and all living things, as well as all the animals that were in the ark. Then God sent a wind across the earth, and the waters subsided.
verses.2: And they remembered the mountains and the heights of heaven. And they scattered the stars from the heavens.
verses.3: And the waters receded from the land, going back and forth. In forty days, there was no water left at all.
verses.4: And the wheat was sown on the seventh day of the month, after seventeen days from the beginning of the month. It was planted on Mount Ararat.
verses.5: And the waters were flowing and overflowing until the twelfth month. On the twelfth day of the month, they became visible from the tops of the mountains.
verses.6: And after forty days, Noach opened the ark that he had made.
verses.7: And he sent the east wind; it blew, and the waters receded from the land.
verses.8: And he sent down rain from above him, so that the waters would subside from the surface of the earth.
verses.9: And she couldn’t find any place where her foot could rest. So she stayed there, in the desert. For water was everywhere on the ground. He reached out his hand, took her, and brought her to him, into the desert.
verses.10: And after another seven days, he began to collect the rain from the sky.
verses.11: And at noon, the sun came upon him. And behold, a prey was in her mouth. Then Noach knew that the waters had receded from the earth.
verses.12: And he continued to suffer for another seventeen days. Then he sent the rain, but it didn’t reach him again.
verses.13: And it happened after six hundred years, at the beginning of one month. The waters receded from the earth. Noah removed the cover of the ark. And he saw that the face of the land was dry again.
verses.14: And in the second month, after seventy-and-twelve days from the beginning of the month, the earth will be ripe.
verses.15: And God spoke to Noah, saying:
verses.16: You and your wife, and your children, and your descendants, go out of the tent.
verses.17: All living things that are in every kind of animal, in birds, and in all creatures that live on the earth, come out from you. They multiply and grow on the earth.
verses.18: And Noah and his sons, along with his wife and their families, went with him.
verses.19: All living things, all birds and all animals that live on the earth, went out from the abyss to their families.
verses.20: And Noah built an ark for Jehovah. He took out all the clean animals and all the clean birds, and he placed them into the ark.
verses.21: And Jehovah loathed the smell of that stench. He said to His heart, “I will not gather together again all those living beings on this land anymore. For man has become evil toward his children. I will no longer gather together all those living beings as I did before.”
verses.22: Every day on this earth, there’s sowing and harvesting, heat and cold, danger and risk. Day and night, they never rest.
